referenceFunction.generalComment: Calculation for transport distances assuming transport by pipeline offshore and onshore as well as sea transport in tanker. Sites and modes of transportation based on the supply situation in 2023. UUID=11054eb8-88bd-3b20-8020-4c01fc532580
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Transportation of crude oil from exploration sites to refineries in CN-region. Includes transport service requirements and emissions from oil handling and evaporation.
referenceFunction.localName: Crude oil, market mix, at long distance transport
referenceFunction.name: Crude oil, market mix, at long distance transport

geography.text: Calculations include production and transport of crude oil from 34 countries.

technology.text: Operation of crude oil pipelines by electricity.

representativeness.productionVolume: 761.4 million tons of directly imported crude oil to CN region in 2023.
representativeness.samplingProcedure: Literature. Online calculators for distances. The consumption mix is calculated based on international trade statistics for 2023.

source.additionalAuthors: Jungbluth N., Bussa M., Stefanel A.
